# Hearts: a mixture model for count data
# Generated from JuliaBUGS.BUGSExamples.VOLUME_2.hearts
using JuliaBUGS

model_def = JuliaBUGS.@bugs("""
model
{
   for (i in 1 : N) {
      y[i] ~ dbin(P[state1[i]], t[i])
      state[i] ~ dbern(theta)
      state1[i] <- state[i] + 1
      t[i] <- x[i] + y[i]
      prop[i] <- P[state1[i]]
   }
   P[1] <- p
   P[2] <- 0
   logit(p) <- alpha
   alpha ~ dnorm(0,1.0E-4)
   beta <- exp(alpha)
   logit(theta) <- delta
   delta ~ dnorm(0, 1.0E-4)
}
""", false)

build_model(data, inits = (;)) = JuliaBUGS.compile(model_def, data, inits)
